title: Chidi gets paid to train AI
caption: Chidi thought "getting paid to chat with AI" was a scam... until Quddus showed him DataAnnotation 🤖💵 General AI tasks from ~$20/hr, coding projects $40+/hr, remote, your own hours. Comment LINK 👇 #remotework #makemoneyonline #ai #sidehustle

scenes.backdrop: city bus stop at night with street lights and a few closed shops

beats.say: Another month, another empty wallet. My wallet now has an echo.
Chidi! Why are you talking to your wallet at a bus stop?
Because nobody else listens. I need a side income I can do from my phone or laptop.
Can you write good English and pay attention to small details?
I once found a typo in my pastor's sermon slides. Live. During service.

beats.text: Perfect. Then look at DataAnnotation. You get paid to help train AI.
beats.say: Perfect. Then look at DataAnnotation. You get paid to help train A.I..

scenes.backdrop: cozy small living room at night with a lamp, posters and plants

beats.text: Train AI? Quddus, I can barely train my dog.
beats.say: Train A.I.? Kuddus, I can barely train my dog.

beats.text: You chat with AI, check its answers, and rate them. For general tasks, they list pay from around twenty dollars an hour.
beats.say: You chat with A.I., check its answers, and rate them. For general tasks, they list pay from around twenty dollars an hour.
Twenty dollars an hour? For reading and judging? I do that to my friends for free!
Remote, and you choose your own hours. But first you must pass their free starter assessment.
Is it open in every country?
Roles vary by country, so check what's open for you. And never pay anyone to get in. It's free.
Assessment starting now. Goodbye echo, hello income.
